configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: A local coverage build, read by gcovr with gcovr.cfg. A coverage number carries its configuration or it is not reproducible, so compare two numbers only when the compiler and the gcovr version are the same. Note this build type is Debug: where a CI leg is Release, an assertion-only case can be registered here and not there, so the two discovered sets are close but need not be identical.
